lint.description: Resolve the packages and analyze their lib and bin directories with dart analyze.

docs-links.description: Check every relative link and anchor in the project's README.md files and doc/ trees; a broken one fails lint.

test.description: Test the packages with flutter test or dart test, and read their JUnit and LCOV reports.

build.description: Build each platform of a Flutter app with flutter build, and each executable of a Dart package with dart compile exe.

workspace-fetch.description: Download the packages each stack root's pubspec.lock names into the pub cache, running none of their code.

workspace-install.description: Resolve the dependencies of each stack root of the workspace with pub get.

force.description: Resolve a stack root even when its last resolution is current

deps-upgrade.description: Upgrade the dependencies of each stack root of the workspace with pub upgrade.

serve.description: Serve a Dart server with dart run, or a Flutter web app with flutter run -d web-server.

entrypoint.description: Dart entry point to serve (defaults to bin/server.dart, else the package's executable)

args.description: Arguments passed to the server program

run.description: Run a Dart command-line package once with dart run and forward its exit code.

entrypoint.description: Entry point to run (defaults to the package's executable)

args.description: Additional arguments to pass to the entrypoint

package.description: Assemble the image of a Dart server application, its entrypoint compiled ahead of time for Linux with dart compile exe, for the docker publish channel.

entrypoint.description: Dart entry point of the image, a file of the package or the name of a bin/ executable (defaults to bin/server.dart, else bin/<package>.dart, else the package's only bin/*.dart)

docker-base-image.description: Replace the distroless cc base with a base pinned by digest (image@sha256:...)

docker-load.description: Also load the assembled image into the local docker daemon

platform.description: Target platform of the image: linux/amd64 or linux/arm64

dry-run.description: Plan the image without assembling it

port.description: Port the image exposes and sets as PORT

publish.description: Push the image of a Dart server application to its OCI registry. A library or a Flutter package publishes nothing.

docker-registry.description: Registry to push the image to, above registries.oci.publish

dry-run.description: Push nothing; report what would be published

lint-run.description: Run the Dart profile's lint steps on one package in its directory, after the SDK version check: dart pub get or flutter pub get, then dart analyze on each of lib and bin that exists. Its inputs are the files the dart:lint selector answers from the resolved profile, which hold no test file, and the stack-root files of the profile.

data.description: The task result: the lint findings of the component.

reports.description: The reports the task wrote or copied: the LCOV and JUnit reports of a test task, the executables of a Dart build.

test-run.description: Run the Dart profile's test steps on one package in its directory, after the SDK version check: flutter test --coverage, or dart test with coverage and format_coverage, then tojunit; then read the JUnit and LCOV reports. A failed case, a step that exits non-zero, or a missing report fails the task.

data.description: The task result: the test and coverage totals of a test task.

reports.description: The reports the task wrote or copied: the LCOV and JUnit reports of a test task, the executables of a Dart build.

build-run.description: Run the Dart profile's build steps on one package in its directory, after the SDK version check: flutter build for each platform directory of a Flutter app that the host builds, or dart compile exe for each bin/*.dart of a Dart package.

data.description: The task result: the outcome of the component's build.

reports.description: The reports the task wrote or copied: the LCOV and JUnit reports of a test task, the executables of a Dart build.

lint-docs.description: Documentation link check: every relative link and anchor in the project's README.md files and doc/ trees must resolve, with the exact case of the file's name. The task body is the SDK's docslinks.Job, shared with every language extension. A link may name any file of the workspace, so the check reads the workspace's Git candidate cut (the tracked files and the untracked files no ignore rule excludes) and its key is the workspace input `git:**`, which holds that cut: deleting or renaming a link target, or editing a heading an anchor names, moves the key, and an ignored file is neither read nor keyed. The project input names the README.md the check starts from, so the key does not fold the project's ignored build output. Outside a Git work tree the check reads the disk and the task has no key. It needs neither Dart nor Flutter.

workspace-install-exec.description: Run pub get --enforce-lockfile at each stack root of the workspace, with flutter when the root holds a Flutter package, except the projects disable.tags excludes and the roots whose package_config.json is newer than their pubspecs and pubspec.lock. Offline, pub resolves from the pub cache alone, and a root whose SDK the machine lacks is left out with a warning.

deps-upgrade-exec.description: Run pub upgrade at each stack root of the workspace with the selected SDK.

serve-run.description: Run a Dart server with dart run and PORT set, or a Flutter app with web/ through flutter run -d web-server on the port, until the user stops it.

run-exec.description: Run dart run with the entrypoint in the package directory and forward its exit code.

install-run.description: Run pub get --enforce-lockfile at the component's stack root, with flutter when the root holds a Flutter package, unless its package_config.json is newer than its pubspecs and pubspec.lock. An offline run resolves nothing: workspace-install resolved every root from the pub cache before.

workspace-fetch-exec.description: Run pub get at each stack root of the workspace, with flutter when the root holds a Flutter package, which downloads the locked packages into the pub cache and runs none of their code.

package-docker.description: Holding the lock of the stack root, check that the selected dart, the one build runs, is 3.8.0 or later, and compile the application's entrypoint with dart compile exe --target-os linux --target-arch <x64|arm64> into a directory of its own; then, with the lock released, assemble a local OCI image of the executable on a digest-pinned distroless cc base, which holds glibc. A library or a Flutter package packages nothing. Sole owner of <command-output>/docker.

docker.description: Local OCI candidate layout, its manifest and the docker channel record.

publish-docker.description: Push the packaged image to the container registry through the shared publisher.

published-image.description: Verified remote image record, written after the registry digest is read back.
